title: Antisolvent engineering enhanced high-entropy liquid flow thermocells with giant power densities for low-grade heat harvesting
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04880J, Paper
Zhuo Liu, Ming Qu, Fan Xu, Zhongyi Li, Fanghao Zhong, Xiang Wei, Dikun Hong, Ruikun Wang, Hongwei Chen, Yangfan Song, Jianyong Ouyang
A cost-effective and facile strategy for enhancing solvation entropy increase of redox ions is proposed through antisolvent engineering, which reaches a giant Pmax/ΔT2 of 64.5 mW m−2 K−2 and ηr of 11.8% with low cost and low temperature resistance.
